headline: Lam Research (NASDAQ:LRCX) Reports Q2 In Line With Expectations, Stock Soars
summary: Semiconductor equipment maker Lam Research (NASDAQ:LRCX) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 30% year on year to $6.72 billion. The company expects next quarter’s revenue to be around $8.1 billion, coming in 13.6% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.82 per share was 8.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
